Also added the requested doc comment on MrrPlanRow.baseMrr ('B866 / SA-277: gross base run-rate, before discounts — ∑ raw basePriceSnapshot.').

- `npx tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json` from the worktree root: clean, exit 0. Had to first run `npm run build -w packages/pricing` because this fresh worktree had no packages/pricing/dist (tsc resolves @routeflow/pricing via the node_modules symlink to that package, unlike jest which maps it straight to src) — a pre-existing environment/build-order gap unrelated to my change, worked around locally so tsc could run.
- Scoped jest run from apps/api: `npx jest src/billing/billing-cron.service.spec.ts src/platform-admin/platform-admin.service.spec.ts src/billing/addon.service.spec.ts src/billing/subscription-mutation.service.spec.ts src/billing/mrr.service.spec.ts src/billing/addon-ledger.spec.ts src/billing/mrr-paying-predicate.parity.spec.ts --maxWorkers=2 --passWithNoTests` ⇒ `Test Suites: 4 failed, 3 passed, 7 total` / `Tests: 10 failed, 1 todo, 301 passed, 312 total` (run both before and after commit, identical result).
- `src/billing/mrr.service.spec.ts` alone: 14/15 pass, including the two tests this task targets: 'T15 REG-B866-BYPLAN byPlan baseMrr is gross, highest first (flips :78 net of discounts, SA-277)' — PASS, and 'T16 REG-B866-BYPLAN prices A(STARTER 99) B(GROWTH 249+addons) C(SCALE 499 fully discounted) D(manual, unpriced) E(addon-rescued) F(SCALE ANNUAL, snapshot=monthly 499) (flips REG-MRR-ANNUAL, SA-277)' — PASS, including its ∑ byPlan.baseMrr === o.baseMrr identity assertion.
- The other 3 failing suites (addon.service.spec.ts: REG-B865-ADMIN tests; subscription-mutation.service.spec.ts; platform-admin.service.spec.ts: REG-B864-TRIAL-OVERRIDE tests) fail on behavior in files FIX-866 does not own (addon.service.ts, subscription-mutation.service.ts, platform-admin.service.ts) and that don't reference MrrPlanRow/byPlan at all — confirmed by grep. These are B864/B865/B863 territory, sibling FIX tasks' scope in this same pipeline round, not something my single-line mrr.service.ts change could have caused or is meant to fix.

No other pre-existing bugs, performance concerns, or out-of-scope behavior found while working this task.
